title: Infinibore Acceleration
description:
Ever since I introduced the infinibore I have worked tirelessly to improve the design and make the fastest possible tunnel bore in minecraft, and with a little help from my friends we managed to achieve it. Introducing the new and improved infinibore which is easier to build, more lag efficient and 10 times faster than the original design. Where the previous design took hours this new machine takes only minutes using some insane tech and engineering.

Infinibore World Download, BE AWARE that the cannon WILL NOT work on different editions of the game such as paper/spigot, purpur or Bedrock edition::
